name: HesabPay Gateway for WooCommerce – Official Plugin
author: Abubakr Sediq

sections.description:
Official HesabPay Gateway for WooCommerce – The #1 plugin to integrate HesabPay with WooCommerce. Seamlessly accept payments, manage vendors, and automate payouts for Afghan and international eCommerce. Officially partnered with HesabPay for maximum reliability.

Integrate HesabPay effortlessly with your WooCommerce store using our official plugin. This HesabPay plugin provides secure, fast, and reliable payment processing tailored for Afghanistan and beyond. Effortlessly manage multi-vendor payouts, real-time exchange rates, and smart translation support. Trusted by businesses and officially partnered with HesabPay, this plugin is your all-in-one solution for modern eCommerce.

Key Features:
– Official HesabPay partnership for trust and reliability
– Easy integration with WooCommerce
– Multi-vendor and automatic payouts
– Real-time exchange rates
– Smart translation and multilingual support
– Secure, seamless checkout for local and international cards
– User-friendly dashboard and settings
– Webhook verification for secure transactions

Why Choose Our HesabPay Plugin?

✓ Official Partnership – Directly partnered with HesabPay
✓ Easy Integration – Simple setup process
✓ Multi-Vendor Support – Full WC Vendor compatibility
✓ Secure Webhooks – Verified transaction processing
✓ 24/7 Support – Professional support team
✓ Regular Updates – Latest features and security patches

Perfect for

• E-commerce stores in Afghanistan
• International businesses accepting Afghan payments
• Multi-vendor marketplaces
• Businesses needing secure payment processing
• Anyone looking to integrate HesabPay with WooCommerce

Features: Free vs Pro

Free Features:
– Enable/Disable HesabPay
– Title & Description
– Sandbox/Live Mode
– API Key Management
– Merchant PIN
– Order Status After Payment
– Basic Debug Mode
– API Exchange Rate (Automatic)
– WC Vendor Plugin Compatible
– Multi-Vendor Support
– Automatic Payouts Only
– Webhook URL

Pro Features (includes all Free features, plus):
– Payment Success/Failure Page (Custom)
– Manual Exchange Rate
– Manual Payouts
– Vendor Commission Settings
– Advanced Debug Tools
– Priority Support
– Hands-on Setup
– WooCommerce Setup
– Multi-Vendor Setup
– Multi-Currency Setup
– Smart Translation

Unlock all Pro features and get priority support: Get the Full Power of HesabPay

Official Partnership

This plugin is officially partnered with HesabPay. For more information, visit hesabpaygateway.com/docs.

Technical Reference

This plugin follows WordPress secure coding best practices with sanitized inputs, nonce verification, and unique prefixes. Webhook verification ensures every payment is validated for fraud protection.

External services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  1. HesabPay API

    • Purpose: To process payments and verify transactions.
    • Data sent: Order details (including product, amount, and customer information) are sent when a payment is initiated.
    • Data received: Payment status and transaction details.
    • Service provider: HesabPay
    • Terms of Service: https://hesabpaygateway.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://hesabpaygateway.com/privacy

  2. ExchangeRate API (https://api.exchangerate-api.com)

    • Purpose: To fetch live currency exchange rates (USD to AFN).
    • Data sent: No personal or order data is sent; only a request for the latest rates.
    • Data received: Current exchange rates.
    • Service provider: ExchangeRate API
    • Terms of Service: https://www.exchangerate-api.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.exchangerate-api.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file from the WordPress plugin directory or hesabpaygateway.com.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > HesabPay to configure your API keys and settings.
  6. Save changes and start accepting payments with HesabPay!

Developer-ready: Deploy via WP Dashboard or Git/SVN with clean, namespace-prefixed code and full compatibility with WooCommerce Blocks.
sections.faq:
How do I integrate HesabPay with WooCommerce?

Simply install and activate our plugin, then configure your API keys in WooCommerce settings.

Is this the official HesabPay plugin?

Yes! We are officially partnered with HesabPay for maximum reliability and support.

Does this plugin support webhook verification?

Yes, our plugin includes secure webhook verification for all transactions.

Does it support multi-vendor stores?

Yes, full support for WC Vendor and multi-vendor setups is included in both Free and Pro versions.

Can I use this plugin outside Afghanistan?

Yes, you can accept both local and international cards.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Visit hesabpaygateway.com/pricing to unlock advanced features and priority support.

Where can I get support?

For support, contact sales@hesabpaygateway.com or visit our support page.
